content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: 12th passed (for SC/ST 10th passed, for 8th passed if others not available); One-year diploma/certificate in PGDCA/DCA/IT from a recognized institution or Data Entry Operator qualification Age limit: 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026) Other conditions: Candidate must be a native resident of the concerned Gram Panchayat Desirable: One-year diploma or certificate (PGDCA, DCA, ITI) from a recognised institution At least six months' experience as data entry operator in a Panchayat

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Janpad Panchayat Bastar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates removed from any government post by the Chhattisgarh Livelihood Promotion Society for indiscipline, misconduct or irregularity Candidates with a living spouse at the time of marriage Candidates who married before the minimum age Candidates with more than two living children, one of whom was born on or after 26-01-2001

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Temporary and contractual appointment for one year Appointment may be terminated with one month notice

content_sections.heading: How Will Janpad Panchayat Bastar Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Merit based on academic marks Bonus marks for work experience in rural development schemes Weightage of marks obtained in minimum educational qualification Bonus marks for experience in rural development works

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested educational certificates Caste certificate Residence certificate Experience certificate if any

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Janpad Panchayat Bastar Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download application form from www.bastar.gov.in or obtain from the office. Submit the filled application along with self-attested documents by the last date. Make sure it reaches by 18 November 2026.

content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date will not be considered

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Janpad Panchayat Bastar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Janpad Panchayat Bastar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 vacancies for Gram Rojgar Sahayak.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Janpad Panchayat Bastar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (www.bastar.gov.in) and send it to कार्यालय जनपद पंचायत बस्तर, जिला बस्तर, (छ.ग.), to reach by 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 9960 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 12th pass (or 10th pass / 8th pass for specific categories) along with IT/Computer diploma.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate must be a native resident of the concerned Gram Panchayat.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates removed from any government post by the Chhattisgarh Livelihood Promotion Society for indiscipline, misconduct or irregularity. Candidates with a living spouse at the time of marriage. Candidates who married before the minimum age. Candidates with more than two living children, one of whom was born on or after 26-01-2001.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit based on academic marks. Bonus marks for work experience in rural development schemes. Weightage of marks obtained in minimum educational qualification. Bonus marks for experience in rural development works.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary and contractual appointment for one year. Appointment may be terminated with one month notice.
